more paper than pen

Three tests for any page

  1. Would a teacher have made this mark?If it is only decoration, remove it.
  2. Is there more paper than pen?Calm page, rare marks.
  3. Recognisable with the logo covered?Highlighter, offset card, handwriting.

Reading

Long-form text

Short answer. Every guide opens with the answer in one paragraph, before any detail.

Body text in guides is 17px with a 68 character line. Links look like this one, with an ink underline and a highlighter band.

  • Lists use the pen colour for bullets
  • One idea per line
A quote uses an ink rule. It is never a decorative pull quote.

Subheading inside a guide

  1. Numbered steps for a process
  2. Each step is one action

FAQ

Is the first class free?

Yes. O Level and A Level classes include a free demo class before you enrol.

Where are classes held?

At DHA Phase 7, Karachi, and live online.

How do I register?

Use the registration form or message us on WhatsApp.
